verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an explicit CLI telemetry opt-out. Users can run `supabase telemetry disable` and check it with `status`, set `SUPABASE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`, or rely on the respected `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` convention, which suits scripted and agent-driven workflows. The documentation covers only the CLI. Missing for 10: opt-out controls for dashboard/Studio and hosted-platform usage tracking, telemetry posture of the MCP server and self-hosted stack, independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.
